Name: The Ranch Expansion Marnie and Jas - Anthro Compatibility Patch
Author: KBKuriations
Description:
Personal patch I made to have Marnie, Jas, Marlon, and [i]a certain spoiler character[/i] keep their anthro species during events from the Ranch Expansion (technically, [i]spoiler character[/i] doesn't have an "official" species in Anthro Characters Continued, but as a relative of a canon character, I made them the same species).

Unfortunately, because my Content Patcher skills are lacking, this is currently a "find and replace" mod: you must find the corresponding files within Lemurkat's assets folders and replace them with mine (they are separated out within the file structure of my zip file, so you should be able to see where they go easily enough). Hopefully perhaps someday in the future I'll properly repackage it as a separate CP mod.

This is made to match version 1.5.8 of the Ranch Expansion. If a future update adds more sprites, I can't guarantee perfect compatibility, but I will try to keep up to date!
